method.method_draft: Count the exposed unit-square faces of the remaining figure directly. From the image, note that each large face is a 3 by 3 grid of unit squares; from the text, each of the 8 corner cubes is removed from a 3 cm cube, so each small cube is 1 cm on a side. After removing the four corner cubes adjacent to any one large face, that face contributes only the center square and the four edge-middle squares, for 5 exposed unit squares per original face. Across the 6 original directions this gives 6 × 5 = 30 exterior unit squares. Each removed corner also creates 3 new exposed unit-square faces inside the notch, and there are 8 corners, giving 8 × 3 = 24 more unit squares. Add 30 + 24 = 54 sq.cm.
